_comment: Nx module boundary enforcement — this is what replaces Spring Modulith's build-time checks. Merged into the root ESLint config once Nx is installed.

depConstraints._comment: Apps may depend on shared packages, never on each other.
contracts is the wire format — it must stay dependency-free so both the browser and every service can import it.
domain holds pure value objects (Money, Area). No I/O, no framework.
Frontend must never import backend internals.
